canonical_name: Read 2 Succeed (R2S) / Read To Succeed Asheville-Buncombe
summary: Read 2 Succeed is an Asheville/Buncombe County literacy nonprofit that recruits volunteer reading tutors who each commit to one K-5 student for a full school year, meeting twice weekly. The listed unit is a 3-session (6-hour) Zoom onboarding training required before tutors start, not the ongoing tutoring itself, but the org's own site describes an active tutor community (monthly 'Tutor Huddles' for coaching and connection, tutor recognition language) that persists beyond the one-off training.

evidence.note: All 3 listings are the same required training series (Jan 14/21/28, 6-8pm Zoom) for new volunteer reading tutors, not a recurring meetup in itself.

Description says tutors 'commit to one student for the full school year' and are 'trained, supported, and deeply connected to a network of people committed to literacy justice' - framing tutors as an ongoing corps, not one-time attendees.

Org's tutor page describes monthly 'Tutor Huddles' offering additional training, coaching, and 'the opportunity for tutors to connect and share ideas' - a standing recurring gathering for the tutor corps.
Page includes a 'R2S Reading Tutors Rock!' section and describes volunteers as 'the heart of our program,' language of membership/identity rather than a rotating commercial audience.
Search turned up a dedicated volunteer-opportunities page and a separate 'Apply to Volunteer' page, indicating an organized, ongoing volunteer program structure beyond a single training event.
